title: TTFT vs end-to-end latency sundial dashboard
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Create a new observability dashboard that contrasts time-to-first-token (TTFT) with end-to-end completion latency across model families and API routes. The purpose is to make latency bottlenecks visible when streaming is enabled vs when requests are served synchronously, and to provide trace links for quick RCA. This dashboard should be usable by SREs and platform/PM to prioritize runtime optimizations (batching, kernel selection, cache warmup).
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard exposes TTFT and end-to-end latency (p50, p95, p99) side-by-side for each model and route
Streaming vs non-streaming toggle that re-slices all panels and cohort comparisons
Per-route filter and model-family dropdown with ability to pin combinations
Panels show cohort breakdowns by request size (token_in, token_out) and concurrency bucket
Each latency datapoint links to a trace or servepath view (trace id / permalink) when available
Dashboard supports 1h, 6h, 24h, 7d, and custom ranges and updates within 30s of metric ingestion
Alertable SLO panels for TTFT_p95 and E2E_p99 with suggested thresholds and playbook link
Unit/integration tests validate correct streaming vs non-streaming partitioning in the pipeline
tasks: Design dashboard mock in Figma and get PM + SRE signoff
Extend metrics pipeline to emit ttft_ms and e2e_ms if not present; add streaming_flag tag
Add aggregation rollups for p50/p95/p99 at 1m granularity by (model, route, streaming_flag)
Implement panels in Grafana (or internal console) with streaming toggle and cohort slicers
Wire trace hook links (trace_id) into latency points and validate via sampling
Add unit tests for metric labeling and e2e test that verifies dashboard panels render expected aggregates
Create runbook/playbook for p95/p99 breaches referencing runtime mitigations (fallthrough to cheaper model variant, increase batch size, KV cache prewarm)

notes: Prefer aggregated rollups to reduce query cost; retain raw metrics for 7 days and 1m-rollups for 30 days.
If sampling of traces is insufficient for p99s, add a short-term adaptive sampler triggered by anomaly alerts.
Make sure streaming_flag is set for older clients that use legacy streaming protocol (backfill logic required).
